_comment: Output tokens/s of the model that recorded each DeepSWE v1.1 trajectory, fitted as the 5th percentile of (agent-step interval / output tokens) over the full 22,490-session corpus (1,704,844 intervals). workload.tool_delays_ms subtracts output_tokens/rate from the recorded interval, leaving the tool wait. Refit by pooling (pre_gap_ms, output_tokens) per source.model over a normalized corpus.
